zh.title: 冬冬
zh.description: 冬冬猫的官方领地 🐾 这里的每一寸空气都属于冬冬。

hero.overline: 2024年9月24日 · 一只毛球的诞生
hero.title: 冬冬的成长史
hero.subtitle: 从手掌大小到拆家担当，一只英国长毛猫的奇幻旅程
hero.scroll: 向下滚动，走进冬冬的故事

chapters.title: 那一天，冬冬来了
chapters.body: 在一个普通的秋日傍晚，一只黑白相间的小毛球钻进了车里。他睁着圆溜溜的眼睛，打量着这个陌生的世界。那天起，冬冬有了家，妈妈有了冬冬。

chapters.title: 第一次信任
chapters.body: 从航空箱里的紧张，到四脚朝天躺在妈妈腿上的放松——冬冬花了整整一周才让肚皮朝上。那是他送给妈妈的第一份礼物：毫无保留的信任。

chapters.title: 新世界的探险家
chapters.body: 桌子的每一寸平面都是待征服的领土，每一件小物件都值得用爪子试探。冬冬的探险原则很简单：先上去，再思考怎么下来。

chapters.title: 捣蛋鬼与撒娇精
chapters.body: 前一秒还在搞破坏被抓个正着，下一秒就窝进怀里打呼噜。冬冬深谙猫生哲学：只要够可爱，就没有犯下的错。

chapters.title: 行走的表情包
chapters.body: 张嘴是惊讶，眯眼是嫌弃，歪头是好奇——冬冬的脸是一部连续剧，每一帧都值得截图。据说有姨姨专门为了他的表情收藏了这个页面。

chapters.title: 猫抓板战士
chapters.body: 猫抓板不只是磨爪工具，更是冬冬的健身器材、情绪出口和艺术品。每一个被挠坏的角落，都是冬冬存在过的证明。

chapters.title: 冬冬的今天
chapters.body: 他还是会在妈妈腿上四脚朝天，还是会为了一只飞蛾扑上窗帘，还是会在每个傍晚守在门口等那个熟悉的脚步声。只是现在，需要更多的毛巾才能把裹住这个大毛球了。

epilogue.title: 故事还在继续…
epilogue.body: 冬冬今天也在好好长大。欢迎常来看他，或者——

en.title: DongDong
en.description: DongDong's official territory 🐾 Every inch of air here belongs to DongDong.

hero.overline: Sep 24, 2024 · A Furry Ball Was Born
hero.title: The Story of DongDong
hero.subtitle: From palm-sized to chaos commander, a British Longhair's incredible journey
hero.scroll: Scroll down to enter DongDong's world

chapters.title: The Day DongDong Arrived
chapters.body: On an ordinary autumn evening, a tiny black-and-white furball climbed into the car. With wide round eyes, he examined this strange new world. From that day on, DongDong had a home, and Mom had DongDong.

chapters.title: First Trust
chapters.body: From the nervous kitten in the carrier to the relaxed belly-up cat on Mom's lap — DongDong took a whole week to show his tummy. That was his first gift to Mom: trust without reservation.

chapters.title: Explorer of the New World
chapters.body: Every inch of table surface is territory to be conquered, every small object deserves a paw test. DongDong's exploration principle is simple: climb up first, figure out how to get down later.

chapters.title: Troublemaker & Cuddlebug
chapters.body: Caught red-pawed making trouble one second, purring in your arms the next. DongDong deeply understands cat philosophy: if you're cute enough, no crime goes unpardoned.

chapters.title: A Walking Meme
chapters.body: Open mouth is shock, squint is judgment, head tilt is curiosity — DongDong's face is a TV series where every frame is screenshot-worthy. Some fans have bookmarked this page just for his expressions.

chapters.title: The Scratching Post Warrior
chapters.body: The scratching post isn't just a nail file — it's a gym, an emotional outlet, and an art piece. Every frayed corner is proof that DongDong was here.

chapters.title: DongDong Today
chapters.body: He still lies belly-up on Mom's lap, still launches at moths on the curtain, still waits by the door every evening for that familiar footsteps. Only now, it takes more towels to wrap this big furball.

epilogue.title: The Story Continues…
epilogue.body: DongDong is growing up nicely every day. Come visit often — or —
